cases.question: What is the equipment loans limit?

policies.title: equipment loans policy
policies.content:
1. Eligibility
The equipment loans policy applies only to permanent employees. Contractors and interns are excluded.

2. Allowance
The equipment loans limit is up to 3 units per week. Written supervisor approval is required before use.

3. Deadline
The equipment loans deadline is within 2 business days after receipt. Extensions require written director approval.

4. Approval
Equipment loans requires approval from the operations manager before booking. Emergency use requires additional director approval.

5. Requirements
For equipment loans, employees must use approved equipment and retain receipts. Personal equipment is prohibited.

6. Exceptions
These rules do not authorize use outside the employee's recorded assignment. Exceptions require both manager and compliance approval.
